note: Trips the player can drive. Clock times are 24-hour. dueMinutes is how long after leaving you're expected. Lines: each moment has a few versions, one picked at random; {due} becomes the time you're expected.

trips.goal: Get Sam to Jess's place for dinner

say: Okay. Fort Lauderdale. Jess said dinner's at {due}, so... no pressure.
Broward Boulevard exit, then it's five minutes. Jess wants us there by {due}.
You know they sit in the median past Hollywood, right?
Little heavy on the gas there.
We're not THAT late.
Okay, I would like to arrive alive, please.
This is not a race. Slow down.
Seriously. Slow. Down.
Are you okay? ...Is the car okay?
Oh my God. Oh my God.
Jess is going to ask what happened to the car.
Whoa!
Jeez!
That was close.
Broward! We're getting there.
Broward County. Halfway-ish.
Our exit's coming up. Broward Boulevard, stay right.
Broward Boulevard in about two miles. Get over to the right.
That... was our exit. Okay. Sunrise, then back down.
You missed it! Take the next one.
Uh, the gas light's on.
We should probably get gas at some point.
Jess just texted 'where are you'.
We're going to be late, aren't we.
Look at that. Early. Jess won't believe it.
Early! Who are you?
Right on time. Nice.
Made it. Told you we would.
Late, but alive. I'll take it.
She saved us plates. Probably.
